summary_he: הסקיל מספק הנחיות עיצוב UI/UX באמצעות סקריפט חיפוש מקומי בפייתון על קבצי CSV/JSON מקומיים (צבעים, גרפים, הנחיות נגישות). בחלק זה לא נמצאו קריאות רשת, איסוף סודות, קוד מוסתר או הזרקת הנחיות. כתיבת קבצים מתבצעת רק לתיקיית design-system בפרויקט, ודריסה של קבצים קיימים מחייבת אישור מפורש מהמשתמש. (נבדק ב-9 חלקים. ההחלטה לפי החלק המחמיר.)

concerns.issue: The agent is told to run a local Python script (scripts/search.py). That script is not part of this part and still needs review. The SKILL.md describes it as stdlib-only and local-data-only.

The --persist option writes design-system/ files into the project directory. It overwrites existing files only with --force, and the instructions explicitly require user authorization before using --force.

The skill instructs the agent to run a local Python script (scripts/search.py) that is not included in this part, so its behaviour could not be verified here. The documented behaviour is local-only search plus optional file writes to design-system/ under a user-specified --output-dir.
The --persist option writes MASTER.md and page files to the project directory. The instructions properly require explicit user authorization before using --force to overwrite existing files.
This is a large static metadata file containing URLs to github.com/google/fonts and fonts.google.com as reference strings only. Nothing in it is fetched or executed.

The --persist option writes design-system files to disk. Files are written relative to the current directory if --output-dir is omitted. The instructions do require --output-dir and explicit user approval before --force.
Static font metadata containing fonts.google.com URLs as reference data. Nothing here instructs the agent to fetch them; benign.

Instructs the agent to execute a bundled Python script (scripts/search.py) via shell; script contents are not in this part and should be verified in other parts to confirm it is local-only with no network or file access beyond the data folder.
--persist writes design-system/ files to a user-specified output directory; the SKILL.md correctly requires --output-dir and forbids --force without user authorization.
Contains many fonts.google.com URLs as reference data only; not fetched automatically by anything shown in this part.

The agent is told to run a local Python script (scripts/search.py) that was not included in this part. With --persist it writes files to the project's design-system/ directory. Overwriting requires --force and explicit user authorization.

Static icon-metadata data only. It contains a GitHub repository URL as a reference, but nothing fetches it. There are a few duplicate codepoints and a future date, which are data-quality issues and not a security risk.
הסוכן מתבקש להריץ סקריפט Python מקומי (scripts/search.py). הסקריפט עצמו אינו כלול בחלק זה ולכן לא נבדק כאן.
האפשרות --persist כותבת קבצי design-system לתיקיית הפרויקט. ההוראות דורשות לציין --output-dir במפורש ולקבל אישור משתמש לפני שימוש ב---force, ולכן זה מצומצם וסביר.
קבצי ה-CSV מכילים כתובות URL לתיעוד (angular.dev, docs.astro.build ועוד). אלה הפניות טקסטואליות בלבד ואינן נשלפות בזמן ריצה.

The search script is run through the shell, and the --persist option writes design-system files to disk. Writes are scoped to the project via --output-dir, and --force requires explicit user authorization. The script itself is not included in this part.
Some code examples contain CDN URLs (jsdelivr, cdnjs). These are reference snippets for the user's own project; the skill does not fetch or run them at runtime.

With --persist the script writes files under design-system/<slug>/ in the given --output-dir, or the current directory if none is given. Paths are protected by safe_slug, and existing files are not overwritten without --force. SKILL.md requires explicit user authorization before using --force.

Tests reference maintainer refresh scripts (refresh-google-fonts.py, refresh-icon-catalog.py). Their --live mode needs GOOGLE_FONTS_API_KEY and presumably calls the Google Fonts API. These are developer tools that the SKILL.md workflow never tells the agent to run.
The data contains fonts.googleapis.com URLs as recommendations to put in generated CSS. The skill never fetches them; they only reach the network if the user ships them in a website.

The --persist option writes design-system/<slug>/MASTER.md and page files to a directory you pass. It overwrites them only with --force, and the instructions require explicit user authorization for --force.
The test loads scripts/evaluate-relevance.py from the repo root at runtime using importlib. That file is local, not remote, but it is not included in this part for review.
The tests spawn subprocesses that run the local search.py with sys.executable. This is benign, local test execution.
